content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NII Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NII Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Scientist-I and Project Scientist-II positions at NII is 12th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Scientist-I?
faq.answer: For Project Scientist-I, candidates need a PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Systems Biology, Biophysics, or a related interdisciplinary field involving computation in life sciences, or a Master's Degree in Engineering and Technology.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for Project Scientist-II?
faq.answer: Yes, for Project Scientist-II, in addition to the PhD and Master's degree qualifications, candidates must have at least three years of experience in Research and Development in industry, academic institutions, or science and technology organizations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for Project Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist-I position offers a salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month, plus 27% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Scientist-II?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist-II position offers a salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month, plus 27% House Rent Allowance (HRA), as per DST OM dated 10.07.2020.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with one post each for Project Scientist-I and Project Scientist-II.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for these positions?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via Email to the Investigator of the project.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for the NII recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for General/OBC candidates. Women and SC/ST/PH candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview, which can be conducted in offline or online mode.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for NII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
